integrity: The all-degree proof uses exact endpoint Legendre kernels and a symmetric block inverse. Checks are finite rational cross-checks only. Literature search cannot rule out unindexed equivalent derivations.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unit-length and unit-density edges, common degree d at least one, continuous values only; proves original-vertex evaluation kernels and sharp evaluation norms, not the full L-infinity projector norm at interior points. Independent scientific validation is not claimed.
title: All-degree kernel cloning for spline projection on bipartite metric graphs
